productArea.name: Webhooks
productArea.scope: Create, edit, and delete user, organization, repository, default, and system webhooks, including providers, URLs, authentication, events, enablement, delivery history, replay, and testing where offered. Git hooks and Actions are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Settings then Webhooks in the seeded repository, and add or open a hook for its configuration and delivery controls.
Choose Webhooks in user settings to manage user hooks and replay deliveries.
Choose Webhooks in Site Administration and select default or system hooks.
Open an organization you can access and choose Settings then Webhooks. Create a disposable organization if none exists.
